review:
Gator Hunters 2 is a 6x5 swamp sequel with scatter wins: eight or more matching symbols anywhere pay and drop away. At the start of each spin a Fire Zone appears somewhere on the grid, at 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 or full size, and special symbols landing inside it gain extra power.

When no wins remain, an Eater symbol steps in. A normal Eater removes symbols, and a stronger version does more. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 30,000x cap. The Fire Zone gives every spin a different hot spot to watch.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
